integrity_statement: The first-public date belongs to the cited foundational source, not to the new result. The formulas and infinite ranges are proved within the accompanying result; computations test finite instances only.
limitations: The parameter metric is a named star with center-leaf distance two and leaf-leaf distance four.
The grade counts leaves at distance one or two from a new point, excluding the center.
The theorem is about nonalgebraic singleton types, not tuples or arbitrary parameter metrics.
Finite checks are supplementary; independent validation and definitive historical-priority assessment are unperformed.
